Diamond & Pearl series · DP

Diamond & Pearl

Released May 1, 2007 · 130 cards

Diamond & Pearl is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Diamond & Pearl series, released in English on May 1, 2007. It has 130 cards. It includes 107 Pokémon, 15 Trainer and 8 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

19 illustrators worked on Diamond & Pearl. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (40), Kouki Saitou (13), Nakaoka (13), Atsuko Nishida (8), Kagemaru Himeno (8), Ryo Ueda (7), Masakazu Fukuda (6), Naoyo Kimura (5).
